items.question: Pooja collected data on tickets sold at Bhopal railway station for a few cities of Madhya Pradesh in two hours: Vidisha 24, Jabalpur 20, Seoni 16, Indore 28, Sagar 16. Her bar graph has a portion erased: no scale numbers on the vertical axis, Sagar bar missing; Vidisha bar is 6 units, Jabalpur 5 units, Seoni about 4 units, Indore about 4.5 units. a) Write the number of tickets sold for Vidisha above the bar. b) Write the number of tickets sold for Jabalpur above the bar. c) The bar for Vidisha is 6 unit lengths and the bar for Jabalpur is 5 unit lengths. What is the scale for this graph? d) Draw the correct bar for Sagar. e) Add the scale of the bar graph by placing the correct numbers on the vertical axis. f) Are the bars for Seoni and Indore correct in this graph? If not, draw the correct bar(s).
steps: Vidisha has 24 tickets in 6 units, and 24 ÷ 6 gives 4 tickets per unit; check Jabalpur: 5 × 4 = 20
Sagar 16 ÷ 4 gives 4 units
Seoni 16 ÷ 4 gives 4 units, so its bar is correct
Indore 28 ÷ 4 gives 7 units, so its bar is too short and must be redrawn
items.answer: a. 24; b. 20; c. 1 unit length = 4 tickets; d. Sagar bar 4 units tall (16); e. Axis 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28; f. Seoni correct, Indore incorrect (should be 7 units for 28)
